name: lens-reader
description: The /lens Reader lens: a third-party extractor's opinion of a page, served from its own Worker so the site bundle never carries a DOM.
$comment: Every wrangler script passes -c wrangler.toml EXPLICITLY. Without it wrangler walks UP the tree, finds the ROOT wrangler.jsonc, and runs its build.command (`node build.mjs`) from this directory, dying with MODULE_NOT_FOUND on a file that only exists at the repo root. CI's steps for cf-garage and lwe-ask have always passed -c for that reason, so the flag looks like ceremony until you drop it: `npm run deploy` then fails in a way no CI run can catch, because CI never invokes these scripts.
